title: Background Radiation Monitor — J305

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "cpm") |> last()

panels.title: CPM — raw and 5-minute mean

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "cpm") |> set(key: "_field", value: "CPM raw")

from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "cpm") |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> set(key: "_field", value: "CPM 5 min mean")

panels.description: Raw CPM plus a 5-minute mean. The raw series preserves fast changes; the mean makes the background trend easier to read.

panels.title: Estimated dose rate (µSv/h)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "usvh") |> last()

panels.description: Estimated from CPM using the counter service USVH_RATIO. Use CPM as the primary measurement unless the detector has been calibrated against a reference instrument.

panels.title: Estimated dose rate — raw and 5-minute mean (µSv/h)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "usvh") |> set(key: "_field", value: "Estimated µSv/h raw")

from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "usvh") |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> set(key: "_field", value: "Estimated µSv/h 5 min mean")

panels.description: Stored estimated dose rate plus a 5-minute mean. The value is not a calibrated dose measurement unless the complete detector has been calibrated.

panels.title: Pulse rate (CPS)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "cps")

panels.description: Raw pulses detected in the most recent one-second window. A stable value near 50 CPS can indicate mains-frequency interference.

panels.title: Detector status

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "detector_status_code") |> last()

panels.description: Current detector state. WARMUP is expected during the first minute after startup; NO_PULSES can indicate a disconnected or bad signal contact.

panels.title: Last pulse age (s)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "last_pulse_age_s") |> last()

panels.description: Seconds since the most recent detected pulse. A steadily increasing value is useful for spotting a disconnected or bad contact.

panels.title: Calibration status

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "calibration_status_code") |> last()

panels.description: UNCALIBRATED by default. Change CALIBRATION_STATUS only after calibrating the complete detector against a suitable reference instrument.

panels.title: CPM → µSv/h factor

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "usvh_ratio") |> last()

panels.description: Current USVH_RATIO used for the estimated dose-rate field.

panels.title: Pulse total since start

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "pulse_total") |> last()

panels.description: Total pulses observed by the counter process since its last start.

panels.title: Counter uptime (s)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "uptime_s") |> last()

panels.description: Counter-process uptime in seconds. A reset to a small value indicates the counter service restarted.

panels.title: CPM statistical uncertainty (1σ)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "cpm_sigma") |> last()

panels.description: Approximate 1σ counting uncertainty for the current 60-second CPM window, using sqrt(N). This describes counting statistics only.

panels.title: Relative statistical uncertainty

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "cpm_relative_uncertainty_pct") |> last()

panels.description: Approximate relative 1σ uncertainty from Poisson counting statistics. It does not include tube response or calibration uncertainty.

panels.title: Estimated dose uncertainty (1σ, µSv/h)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "usvh_sigma") |> last()

panels.description: Counting-statistics contribution only. The uncertainty of the J305 conversion factor is additional and is not included until calibration.

description: J305 background-radiation monitor with signal diagnostics and Poisson counting uncertainty. CPM is the primary measurement; µSv/h remains an estimate until the complete detector is calibrated.
